scope: Current CATALOG_WORDS, canonical cards only; 32 raw-source aliases excluded.
method: Model visual first review of 87 rendered contact sheets (36 cards per sheet), with all four fields visible, plus enlarged rechecks. Automated existence/decoding checks do not prove semantic quality.
boundaries: This is an initial model review, not a teacher certification or a guarantee of no remaining errors.
No pronunciation or physical-iPad acceptance was performed in this review.
No application vocabulary, pictures, audio, or learning records were changed.
Alternative valid contexts and natural nonliteral translations are not automatically errors.
